Info

Implementation of IInstructionLineParser dispatching and parsing statement lines.

class scaralang.core.service.parser.instruction.instruction_line_parser.InstructionLineParser(*, handlers: Sequence[ICommandParser])[source]¶

Bases: object

Dispatches statement line tokens to registered command handlers.

It defines:

attributes:
name - Identifier name of the line parser.
handlers - Registered command parser handlers.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes InstructionLineParser with registered command handlers.
parse_line - Parses single statement token tuple into a ScaraInstruction.
_handlers: tuple[ICommandParser, ...]¶
_registry: dict[str, ICommandParser]¶
property handlers: tuple[ICommandParser, ...]¶

Gets the registered command handlers.

Returns:

Tuple of registered ICommandParser handlers.

property name: str¶

Gets the line parser identifier name.

Returns:

Line parser name string.

parse_line(*, tokens: tuple[ScaraToken, ...]) → ScaraInstruction[source]¶

Parses a statement token slice into a structured ScaraInstruction AST node.

Parameters:

tokens – Statement token tuple including command keyword.

Returns:

ScaraInstruction AST node.

Exceptions:

ScaraSyntaxError if empty tokens or no handler recognizes command.
